verdict.rationale: Okta event hooks fire outbound HTTPS calls automatically when specified org events occur, which gives event-driven background automation. The signup page also says the platform lets you "manage and automate Okta." However, the automation logic has to live in an external service the user builds and hosts. The MCP server is agent- and prompt-driven rather than autonomous background execution. Missing for 10: a native first-party automation or workflow builder, scheduled or recurring jobs, autonomous agent execution without a human prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
